shared_baseline_storage: Identical references across all63evaluations stored once for training_probe,diagnostic,final; raw copies checked before omission.

predeclared_assessment.interpretation: Pragmatic descriptive screens; related groups/seed-runs dependent. Supplied query selection is not learned routing. No causal diagnosis.

limitations: Truth categories use known counterpart/target labels; they are not input-only guessing rules.
Repeated seeds/variants share groups; pooled counts and per-delay subsets are descriptive, not independent samples.
Same class does not imply identical logits or hidden states; these were not retained.
The initial-selected arm uses a trained reader over an initial encoder; it is not an untrained-reader baseline.

Trained-versus-initial encoder features are compared on the same final groups after the same reader-training protocol; this is a paired feature-condition contrast, not a direct test of the original QUERY transition or population-general training causality.
A query intervention isolates output response for these fixed models; it does not identify an internal algorithm.
Selected-versus-mean comparisons bundle readout policy, effective expressivity and resulting optimization; they do not isolate query information alone.
Different delay strata have different histories/label balances; their differences do not identify a causal forgetting curve.

posthoc_same_reader_query_corruption.algebra: The two-query swap is a bijection, so total swapped correctness equals the saved other-candidate truth-category count.
limitations: Post hoc descriptive fixed-sample comparison, with shared groups across seeds and variants; not independent samples or population inference.
Only the two recorded queried keys are covered, not arbitrary key permutations or all four possible keys.

Same fitted reader removes the separately-trained-blind-reader comparison difference for this finite output audit; it does not identify internal representation, original QUERY-transition failure, or learned routing.
Small or mixed net differences do not prove equivalence or absence of query effects; distinct original-only and swapped-only rows can cancel.
Original paired-query/full-quartet criteria and negative outcomes remain unchanged.
posthoc_same_reader_query_corruption.method: For each saved final row, substitute the recorded prediction for the other queried key under the identical(group,assignment) history; score against this row target. No model or new key is evaluated.

query_only_state_boundary: Query-only variants share identical cached pre-query states by construction. Equal classes need not mean equal reader logits. Earlier-value swaps may change history states; class equality does not establish state equality there.
feature_condition_interpretation: Initial encoder means an untrained encoder with a trained reader. Trained/initial selected readers use matched readout protocol, not a direct test of the old QUERY transition.
blind_comparison_interpretation: Separate learned policies bundle selection/mean, effective expressivity and gradients; nominal parameter equality does not isolate query information. Near-equal individual accuracy is not equivalence.
query_corruption_interpretation: Other recorded-key output is scored against the original target on identical saved histories. Fixed-sample paired corruption check, two available keys only; not a deployed input-only predictor or population claim.

native_environment.limitation: Prior full census hash; current path/size checks do not detect same-size package edits

next_question.question: Can a nonlinear reader improve complete keyed recall from the same frozen trained states beyond matched factorized identity and direct linear references?
alternatives: Learned keyed write/read or delta-rule state with matched actual budgets.

disclosure.snapshots: Safe FP32 filenames,inventories,hashes only; full weights retained locally.

limitations: Related groups and repeated seed-runs are dependent; pooled counts are descriptive.
Supplied key selection is not learned routing; blind mean is not equally expressive.
A positive probe does not identify the old failure cause; a negative cannot prove information absent.
No original model, installed application, general-language quality or running-memory improvement is established.
